page.layout: One block: a title page inside a decorative woodcut border, lines centred. Below the title, the text is hidden by the grey colour card.

main_text.l: GRYNAEO, quum is, Aprilis die XV Anno Christianae

page.notes: The grey colour card hides the lower part of the title; only the end of the last visible line ("habitis.") shows, so the hidden line is marked illegible. The handwriting at the top left ("40 Diss. 3234 (17") and the pencilled or stamped marks at the top are not printed text and are left out. The colour and grey-scale target cards are not part of the page. The printed "u" in "Controuersia" is written "v" in the transcription, following the u/v rule. "IOHANNE IACOBO" is written "JOHANNE JACOBO" for the same reason. The text is printed as the title page of a separate disputation synopsis and has no running head, page number or catchword.
